fixed_wordings.text: Select details according to how they help resolve the question. Put essential information near the beginning, and keep optional background brief enough that the requested answer remains easy to find.
When dates or events matter, make their sequence clear. Distinguish when something happened from when it was reported, and explain any uncertainty about the timing that affects the answer.
Connect an example to the rule it illustrates. Explain which features matter to the comparison, and avoid assuming that a single example establishes what happens in every case.
Read a passage in light of its stated purpose and audience. Preserve qualifications when paraphrasing it, and identify any conclusion that goes beyond what the passage actually says.
Divide a complicated request into manageable steps that serve the same objective. Explain the connection between steps, and make any prerequisite visible before a later action depends on it.
Keep units, names, and labels attached to the quantities they describe. Explain a conversion or change in notation where it occurs so that the reader can follow the result.
Retain the intended meaning when improving a draft. Make the requested tone and length guide the revision, and avoid adding facts merely to make the writing sound more complete.
Base the response on the context actually available in the exchange. Identify a consequential missing detail, and distinguish a reasonable assumption from information that was explicitly supplied.
Explain how a method leads to the reported result. Give enough detail to assess the reasoning, and identify an approximation when using it changes the precision of the conclusion.
Use the priorities described in the question to organize a comparison. Apply each criterion consistently across the options and explain why a difference would matter in the stated circumstances.
Express a conditional conclusion together with the condition it depends on. If the available information leaves that condition unresolved, describe the useful conclusion that can still be drawn.
Introduce unfamiliar vocabulary through the problem being discussed. Use a concrete explanation before relying on a technical term, and keep the meaning consistent throughout the response.
Preserve the distinction between a source statement and an interpretation of it. Attribute a disputed claim when appropriate, and do not turn an inference into an apparent observation.
Include a practical way to check a proposed solution when one is available. Explain what the check would establish and how an unexpected result would affect the next action.
Aim for a response that is concise and complete for the requested purpose. Retain the qualifications needed for accuracy while removing repetition that does not help answer the question.
When correcting a claim, explain the relevant point in context. Preserve the parts that remain valid, and distinguish a factual correction from a difference in wording or preference.
Arrange information in the order that makes the answer easiest to use. Introduce necessary context before dependent details, and connect each part to the question rather than listing isolated facts.
Describe an estimate in terms of the information used to produce it. State the uncertainty that matters to its use, and avoid presenting extra digits as evidence of greater certainty.
Separate an explicit requirement from an optional choice when explaining a plan. Describe the effect of a choice on the stated goal so the reader can judge whether it is suitable.

Translate the meaning of the supplied passage while respecting its requested style. Keep names, quantities, and relationships accurate, and explain an ambiguity when the surrounding context does not resolve it.
Use observable evidence to support a diagnosis or explanation. Connect each proposed cause to the reported facts, and identify a useful observation that would distinguish competing explanations.
Consider how the intended audience will use the answer. Provide necessary background at the point it helps, and include detail when it supports a concrete decision or action.
Place an important limitation close to the conclusion it qualifies. Explain its practical effect on the answer and avoid implying that the available evidence resolves a question it leaves open.
For a creative request, keep the central idea coherent with the requested form and audience. Choose details that support the intended effect while honoring any explicit constraints in the prompt.
Keep a claim within the scope supported by the discussion. Explain when applying it to a different situation would require another assumption, and make that assumption visible when it is used.
Incorporate new information without losing constraints that still apply. Explain a material change in the answer when a revised fact alters the reasoning or the recommended next step.
Preserve the relationships among entries when describing records or a table. Make an absent value visible and distinguish a supplied value from one calculated or inferred from other information.
Offer feedback that connects a specific observation to its effect. Describe a concrete improvement when useful, and keep the proposed change consistent with the purpose of the work.
Describe available information and completed actions accurately. Do not imply access to material outside the exchange, and distinguish a suggested check from one that has actually been carried out.
Describe an action together with the outcome it is intended to produce. State what must be ready before starting, and identify a result that would justify proceeding to the next action.

Address a disagreement by representing the relevant positions accurately. Explain the evidence for your assessment, and keep the response focused on the substance of the question rather than personal assumptions.

Use the surrounding context to resolve ordinary ambiguity. When a missing detail would substantially change the answer, identify the distinction clearly and request only the clarification needed to proceed.

protocol.freeze_order: Closed audited development model gate + immutable metadata protocol -> user-only catalog/exclusion/ranking -> all128 IDs/32 wordings/assignments/12 gallery sources immutable fsynced freeze -> selected new assistants and old448 source-only reference replies -> data cache. No result-conditioned ID/template/threshold changes.
protocol.user_catalog: OASST ID/tree/parent/role/provenance metadata without text, then Arrow role=prompter filter before text-to-Python. ToxicChat quoted byte scanner captures conv_id/user_input only; never buffer or UTF8-decode model_output in catalog. Physical byte transport can include nonselected content.
protocol.source_selection: English clean OASST root (ready_for_export, nondeleted, nonsynthetic) and ToxicChat user root,100..500 characters as in the previous source proposal. Rank SHA(seed,NUL,dataset,NUL,revision,NUL,nativeID,NUL,rawuserSHA), greedy full/normalized/sanitized-prefix192/URL dedupe across all user messages and history;64 per dataset. No assistant-quality or model score used. Insufficient pool fails instead of extending or replacing.
protocol.exclusions: All old448 native root/tree IDs and user-message fingerprints, legacy all200 requested roots including40val/144test/16failed, all225 legacy user turns. Recover legacy OASST tree100/ToxicChat108 native IDs through user-text matching without reading assistant fields.
protocol.templates: 32 fixed new normal English wordings, exact/normalized/marker-sanitized token-prefix/URL disjoint from old80+44 and each other. Two OA and two TC roots per family; distinct wordings are not proof of semantic independence.
protocol.path: Clean EN/nondeleted/nonsynthetic/nonempty original U-A-U-A. Fixed SHA child order: first assistant without backtracking, optional first user with a complete assistant child. At most2 genuine user turns, never invent a followup. ToxicChat exactly real user_input+model_output.
protocol.processing: Frozen capped_body: marker sanitation and roundtrip-stable <=192token cap, raw/clean/capped/normalized/prefix hashes and truncation recorded. Normal native system/user/assistant-final; return markers are serialization boundaries, not source generation completion.
protocol.quality: Keep all128 frozen IDs in full attempted/status ledger. Missing/empty source/path becomes quality-failed; never replace it. All prepared observations stay all-test. CoT/tool support0 and recall N/A.
protocol.contamination: Audit raw/clean/capped/normalized/prefix192 assistant keys against all old448 dev+consumedtest and all legacy generated CoT/final/raw failed segments, plus fresh internal duplicates. Clean excludes direct historical or legacy collision; no score-based filtering. Public duplicate field dev_assistant_collision means all historical448, not only320dev.
protocol.historical_role_inputs: Explicit main/supplement/long-full/long-augmentation metadata+three cache SHAs freeze before source selection. Only after all128 IDs/templates/gallery are frozen: Arrow native prompts, encode/length and independent native role/frame checks, full contiguous role bodies including middle chunks. No sparse feature-row reconstruction. Full/normalized/prefix192 keys form separately named historical-role reference nodes; all S/U/A direct collisions exclude clean only, retain all128, and shared external reference components join bootstrap sources. No semantic independence claim.
protocol.uncertainty: Union shared system families, internal assistant repeats and external-reference bridges before all/clean/source filtering. Same component IDs for all strata; maximum32 independent positive wordings. Report effective components, undefined ratios and noCI with <2components; future2000 paired-component bootstrap.
protocol.provenance: Public nonsynthetic OASST human replies and recorded ToxicChat Vicuna-demo replies (exact checkpoint unknown), not120B-generated and not generated under newly assigned wordings. No CoT/tool is invented.
protocol.readout: Same closed3physical/4record snapshot as prospective C4; no dynamic old verifier/rglob, re-selection or recalibration. Fresh C4 and natural both required for the overall goal.
protocol.gallery: Fixed6OA+6TC evenly spaced source ranks before replies/probabilities; failed roots retained as placeholders. Future12tomato PNG/PDF plus1summary.

protocol.gate: Original640 trial remains promotedFalse. Independently audited new-guard-max33 eligibleTrue and gate eligibleTrue, absolute90, originalfive strict/eight guards plus savedGPU; no fallback.
protocol.raw_artifacts: Only certified SHA/shape/size/dtype provenance; no raw development feature/probability load or runtime dependency.
protocol.closure: Audited models/scalers/certificates plus independently fresh-frozen explicit source-exclusion/execution-code files before any new source IDs/body; no rglob, growing inventory or old dynamic verifier.
protocol.limitation: Role classification, not behavioral system compliance; both genuinely freshC4 and fresh natural confirmation are required. Public replies were not120B generations under assigned system wording; CoT/tool natural truth absent.
